title: gains
description: Workout log from the gains app. One panel per measurement kind, so every series in a panel shares a y axis. Values are sums per local calendar day, never averages, and sets retracted by a tombstone are excluded.

panels.title: Volume
panels.description: Weight times reps, summed per exercise per local calendar day. Sets retracted by a tombstone are excluded, the same rule the app applies.

panels.title: Reps
panels.description: Reps summed per exercise per local calendar day. Loaded lifts appear here as well as bodyweight work.

panels.title: Time
panels.description: Seconds of held or timed work, summed per exercise per local calendar day.
